About me

Welcome to my world of tattoos

Hey, I'm René, a tattoo artist based in Bushwick, Brooklyn. I pour my heart into every piece, aiming to reflect each client's unique story. My focus is realistic black & grey designs with meticulous attention to detail, creating a lasting impact my clients carry every day.

Whether you're after something small and meaningful or a large, intricate design, I'm here to bring your ideas to life. Tattoos are more than ink: they're a personal journey, a shared connection, and art that stays with you forever.

I'll guide you through each step so you feel comfortable and excited. Let's create something extraordinary together.

Let's talk about your idea
What I do

Services

Custom Realism

One-of-a-kind black & grey realism: portraits, animals, statues and scenes designed around your story.

Sleeves & Large Pieces

Full sleeves, half sleeves, legs and back pieces planned over multiple sessions with flowing composition.

Portraits

Loved ones, icons, or faces that mean something, rendered with lifelike depth and soft shading.

NYC & Concept Work

Brooklyn landmarks, skylines and surreal storytelling built into one connected design.

Small & Meaningful

Compact detailed pieces with big significance.

Cover-Ups & Touch-Ups

Reworking older tattoos into something you're proud of. Send a photo with your quote request.

Pricing depends on size, detail and placement. Send your idea, size and placement for a personalized quote.

Good to know

FAQ

How do I get a quote?

Use the Request a Quote page with your idea, size and placement. You can also DM on Instagram.

Do you do custom designs only?

Yes, each tattoo is a collaboration tailored to you.

How much does it hurt?

It depends on placement. Use the pain meter on the Booking page.

How should I prepare?

Eat, hydrate, sleep well, avoid alcohol and wear comfortable clothing that gives access to the area.

How long do sleeves take?

Large pieces are planned across several sessions depending on detail and size.

How do I care for it after?

You'll get step-by-step aftercare instructions at the end of your session.

Do you require a deposit?

A deposit typically secures your date. Details are confirmed when your booking is accepted.
